# Varnam

Varnam is an ultra-premium, interactive, and cinematic digital wedding invitation platform. It allows users to create bespoke, luxury-tier digital wedding e-invites shareable with a single link on WhatsApp, SMS, or email.

## Main Pages

- [Home Page](https://varnam.co/) - Premium cinematic digital wedding invitations with RSVP tracker.
- [Templates Gallery](https://varnam.co/templates) - Handcrafted templates collection for Hindu, Muslim, Christian, and Secular weddings.
- [Privacy Policy](https://varnam.co/privacy-policy) - Privacy and security guidelines.
- [Terms of Service](https://varnam.co/terms-of-service) - Licensing terms and conditions.

## Key Features

- **Cinematic Entrance Animations**: Double-door reveals, royal Tamil themes, divine temple aesthetics, and champagne floral transitions.
- **Dynamic RSVP Tracking**: Online RSVP management with attendance logs, guest counts, and guest wish boards.
- **Event Information & Schedules**: Interactive multi-event schedules (Muhurtham, Reception, Sangeet) with dress code specifications, transit instructions, and active directions.
- **Media & Slideshow Integration**: Customized background image uploads, photo slideshow galleries, and support for elegant background music tracks.
- **No App Required**: Built on modern web technologies ensuring compatibility across any mobile and desktop browser.

## Pricing

- [Pricing Details](https://varnam.co/#pricing) - One-time payment of ₹799 per premium invitation website. Free drafting, activation on payment.

## Templates Collection

1. [Temple Gold Template](https://varnam.co/templates/temple-gold) - Divine temple drawing animations, floats brass lamps, Tamil Hindu aesthetics.
2. [Traditional Red Template](https://varnam.co/templates/traditional-red) - South Indian silk textures, self-drawing Kolams, falling jasmine.
3. [Royal Tamil Template](https://varnam.co/templates/royal-tamil) - Deep crimson design featuring custom classical Tamil visual cues.
4. [Floral Luxury Template](https://varnam.co/templates/floral-luxury) - Destination theme, champagne gold and blush pink tones.
5. [Modern Minimal Template](https://varnam.co/templates/modern-minimal) - Contemporary motion typography and clean beige layout.
6. [Modern Christian Template](https://varnam.co/templates/modern-christian) - Celestial rose theme, cross transitions, string instrumentals.
7. [Luxury Floral Template](https://varnam.co/templates/luxury-floral) - Sophisticated destination theme with organic floral designs.
8. [Elegant Muslim Template](https://varnam.co/templates/elegant-muslim) - Emerald green and glistening gold mandalas.
